judgments.rewrite_hint: 「Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.」の「with users」を、電話をかけた相手を指す表現に狭めてください（例: “with the people they called”）。参照: MUSE-HC-006

「The test began without properly telling people what was happening. So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.」から、人々が実際にAIと話していると思っていたという断定を削除し、適切な開示なしにテストが始まったという確認済みの範囲にとどめてください。参照: MUSE-HC-012

「the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.」の後半を、電話の遂行にユーザー情報が必要な場合に機微情報が契約スタッフへ共有される可能性がある、という条件付きの表現に狭めてください。参照: MUSE-HC-010
